Hi everyone,
As one half of an international couple, i know how hard it must be to find a job for your partner here in Israel, so as it happens my client is hiring a bilingual Thai speaker (with Hebrew or English) and i told them i might be able to help (while having this group on my mind)
So if any of you have a partner who speaks Thai and is looking for work - contact me :)

Wishing Shana Tova to everyone!
